arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Juggernaut Core{/c} Skills are empowered, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage to the first enemy hit and storing the damage dealt to that target, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} times. 

{c_important}Fortress{/c} unleashes this stored damage to all enemies within its area.
